About

I develop ideas for hospitality and lifestyle brands and take them through to the films, photography and events that carry them. A lot of the work starts with a constraint.

I started on a hotel front desk in Bucharest in 2018. You find out quickly what guests notice and what they walk straight past. Four years at HotelPlanner followed, in EMEA sales and then product management, before I moved into marketing in 2023. Since 2025 I have also worked with a cybersecurity startup, partly to find out whether the way I think holds up somewhere with no marble in it.

Hospitality · Café Athénée · 2023–2024

Café Athénée
Rebrand & reopening

The café was still a building site.
So we shot there.

My role

Tone of voice·Visual direction·Copy·Photography direction·PR & influencers·Reopening concept

Ownership

Proposed and developed. Final approval sat with the hotel's Marketing Manager and General Manager.

Outcome

After it opened, visitors and creators began describing the café in the same Parisian terms we had been working towards, and started approaching it asking to film. Observed, not measured.

The café was still a building site. So we shot there.

Café Athénée sits beside the Romanian Athenaeum, on a street that already feels a little Parisian. That was the feeling the reopened café was meant to have. It was also still under renovation, with no finished room to photograph.

I had seen a Paris hotel use its own renovation as material rather than working around it. I proposed the same here: shoot on the site itself. Chefs in whites against scaffolding, desserts on saw blades and marble offcuts, cocktails on paint-worn ladders. I built the moodboard, presented the direction internally, and it was approved on the first presentation.

Campaign photography — directed by Theodora Otelea

Chapter IV · 2025 · the reopening

The English Bar has been part of Athénée Palace since 1914. It closed for renovation, and we wanted the reopening to bring new attention to it without losing what makes it distinctive.

I proposed using the visual language of silent cinema to take the bar back to the year it opened. Three chapters stayed in black and white. The fourth arrived in the present — and in colour — for the 2025 reopening. The room itself was closed while we filmed, so the earlier chapters were shot in other heritage spaces in the hotel.

Hospitality · JORJ Restaurant · June 2025

JORJ
Fire & Ice

Fire & Ice already existed in the kitchen.
I adapted it into an opening night.

My role

Event concept adaptation·Guest journey·Partner integration·Invitation language·Dress code·Performer selection

Ownership

The concept was adapted from JORJ's existing culinary idea and presented to the hotel's owner. I did not source, contract or negotiate the partnerships.

Partners

Guerlain · Ruinart · Moët · Teilor

Fire & Ice already existed in the kitchen. I adapted it into an opening night.

JORJ opened in June 2025 with fire and ice already behind the cuisine. It had not been built as something guests could walk through. Two zones, joined by a lit bridge, and a dress code so the room carried the concept as well.

Guerlain, Ruinart, Moët and Teilor are long-standing partners of the hotel. Rather than placing them at the edges of the evening, I proposed positions for them inside the two zones.

Avencyx
Content strategy & communication

I was asked for social strategy.
I built the system the posts would belong to.

My role

Social strategy·Tone of voice·Four content pillars·10-film data privacy series·Founder positioning·Repeatable content formats

Founder

Catalin Patrascu — formerly CERT-RO · ENISA expert · Council of Europe · fifteen years in the field.

Status

The website has launched and the first films are live.

I was asked for social strategy. I built the system the posts would belong to.

Cybersecurity is difficult to communicate: too technical for a general audience, or too vague to hold credibility with the industry. I defined four content pillars and the tone of voice that sits under them, then produced the content that runs through the system.
